assessment.intent: To teach appliance repair business owners what makes an effective local service website, using ABC Appliance as a concrete case study.
assessment.specificity: High. Names specific page types (appliance category, brand, contact), exact intake distinctions (request versus confirmed appointment), and concrete local communities served.
assessment.evidence: Grounded in the ABC Appliance live website features and Google's published local ranking guidance.
assessment.voice: Conversational, direct, and practical. Uses Canadian spelling, explains terms before using them, and frames recommendations as Michael's advice for busy owners.
assessment.usefulAsset: Yes. Gives owners a clear page architecture, honest booking language guidance, and a local ranking worksheet they can act on.
